semiconductor_relevance: High — Nabu Optical Systems specializes in maskless direct-write lithography tools that are crucial for semiconductor prototyping and low-volume production.
summary: Nabu Optical Systems develops advanced maskless direct-write lithography tools, specifically the ANU-1, which enables rapid prototyping and low-volume production without the need for traditional photomasks. This innovation allows semiconductor designers to iterate designs quickly and efficiently, significantly reducing time and costs associated with traditional lithography methods.
